item.title: 15,000 calls and counting — Sen. Mark Kelly issues urgent plea in 11th day of Nancy Guthrie search
item.description: Arizona Sen. Mark Kelly briefly spoke with reporters outside the Capitol Wednesday on the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, mother of Today show's Savannah Guthrie, reports ABC News.

item.title: Spreading the love: Seniors celebrate Valentine’s Day with Chicanos Por La Causa
item.description: As Valentine’s Day is quickly approaching, dozens of seniors on the westside were already dressed up in red and pink on Wednesday at an event hosted by Chicanos Por La Causa.

item.title: More activity, no breaks on Nancy Guthrie disappearance
item.description: It caused a new flurry of activity Tuesday when the FBI released pictures and video of a masked man, with a gun, caught on the home’s doorbell camera.
